text:
Jess: Customer reported incorrect tool_result mapping when we call multiple tools in parallel. They see tool A output attached to tool B's call id.
Devon: ugh, that's bad. do we have a repro or request id?
Jess: customer sent request id req_42b7. payload has two tool calls: translate() and classify(). Both returned 200 but the tool_result tag in the main response points to classify for both.
Mia: can you paste the raw request/response? obfuscate PII.
Jess: here's sanitized snippet:
```
{"id":"req_42b7","tools":[{"name":"translate","args":{"text":"Hello"}},{"name":"classify","args":{"text":"Hello"}}]}
```
Response headers:
```
x-request-id: req_42b7
x-tools: [translate:call_101, classify:call_102]
```
Final body (truncated):
```
{"tool_results":{"call_101":{"result_id":"r_102"},"call_102":{"result_id":"r_102"}}}
```
Devon: so both call_101 and call_102 map to r_102. looks like result dedup or tag collision in parallel merge step.
Sam: could be our tool_result association using a non-unique key when responses arrive out-of-order. maybe we use model-generated tag instead of call id.
Mia: also saw schema validation logs: incoming tool metadata missing a required `call_index` in some submissions. if call_index absent we fallback to `tool_name` which can collide.
Jess: customer says it happens intermittently under load.
infra-bot: alert: high concurrency on /v1/call-tools route from cust-789, 95th latency 1.8s, errors 0.2%.
Devon: assigning to oncall-eng to triage: @oncall-eng can you take a look? cc @Sam
oncall-eng: looking. grabbing logs for req_42b7 now. any repro steps preferred?
Jess: steps from customer: run two tool calls in parallel (same text), repeat 1000x. seeing ~1/500 hits.
Sam: quick theory: we hash tool args to dedupe results and then attach dedupe id back to both calls if identical; bug when dedupe map key collides with call id namespace.
Mia: that matches the truncated body: result_id r_102 reused. check function that generates result_id: `generate_result_key(reqId, toolIndex)` — maybe toolIndex not set.
oncall-eng: repro locally with small script -> reproduced at ~1/200 on my machine when run with concurrency 64. stack shows merge phase calls `assoc_results_by_tag` using `tag` field from worker responses. worker uses `tag` = `args.hash` if `call_index` absent.
Devon: mitigation idea: require `call_index` in the router schema (reject/400) OR fallback to stable sequence number from request body (not args.hash).
Sam: short-term patch: update merger to prefer `call_id` traced in response headers (`x-tool-call-id`) over worker `tag`.
Mia: agree. will open PR for merger change. also add a schema validation rule to ensure call_index present and add a metric for tag collisions.
Jess: customer wants timeline and whether data exposure risk exists. does this map wrong risk any PII crossing? looks like not — it's just association mismatch but same object text. confirm?
oncall-eng: confirmed: no payload mixing between different customers. only mapping issue inside same request. no PII leak.
Devon: next actions: (1) oncall-eng to deploy hotfix to prefer `x-tool-call-id` (hotfix branch), (2) Mia to open PR for router schema validation with 24h SLA, (3) Sam to add collision metric + alert, (4) Support to update customer with repro and ETA.
Jess: filing support ticket for cust-789 with ETA ~3h for hotfix test, 24h for router schema patch.
Sam: logging note: add structured trace id to tool worker responses: `tool_call_id` header. that'll make future merges deterministic.
oncall-eng: will do hotfix deploy to canary in 30m and monitor. tagging incident ID INC-2026-312.
Jess: thanks everyone. I'll update the customer and move thread to incidents if hotfix becomes a full incident. :thumbsup:
